correctness.rationale: Checked original scheme/field hypotheses, reduced dual, rational rather than global morphism and degree convention. Direct characteristic-two coordinate transform gives F=UVT+W²(U+V+T); Euler polar relation makes o a strange smooth point. On U=1 w²=yz/(1+y+z), nonsquare by prime y=0 valuation. Polar cubics G=(VT(V+T),UT(U+T),UV(U+V)) have exactly seven simple F2-plane basepoints and span cubic equations vanishing at them, confirmed independently by GF2 evaluation rank7. Source rational identities z²=r(r+1)/t(t+1), y²=r(r+t)/(1+t), w²=r/(1+t) force degree2 each stage and k(X)²=k(r,t), since [k(X):k(X)²]=4 by p-basis over perfect k. Independent symbolic checker confirmed coordinate identity and linear-system rank; proof handles infinite-function-field conclusions, and direct valuations are essential. Blowup anticanonical class 3H−ΣE_i has degree2; no assertion of del Pezzo general position.

value.rationale: The drastic degeneration of the Cayley cubic dual from classical Steiner quartic to a plane in characteristic two, plus exact Frobenius Gauss extension and seven-point net factorization, is a motivated geometric classification of a canonical singular surface. The inseparability degree and factorization explain dual degeneration, beyond a trivial coordinate substitution.

final_claim: For Cayley cubic e3(x0,x1,x2,x3)=0 over algebraically closed char2, smooth point o=[1:1:1:1] lies in every tangent plane; reduced dual is the plane sum ai=0. The Gauss function-field extension is purely inseparable height1 degree4 exactly k(X)^2. It factors as projection from o of degree2 followed by degree2 planar map defined by complete cubic net through the seven F2-points of P2; blowup resolves anticanonical net.
